Notes: Every native row identifies the packaged source array/index and original label; RecordSource points to a wrapped event only after exact native request-ID correlation.

Native management projections came from LookupEvents, whereas the ten data records came from conventional gzip S3 delivery. Replay adds a local Management selector to exercise these same projections in actual gzip delivery after backend reopen; it does not misattribute native management capture to the data-only trail.

Native account IDs rebind to 123456789012/222222222222; issued aliases and bucket canonical owner bind from responses. Audit timestamps, request IDs, Host and serialized byte accounting are correlated by the existing runner.
The native upload is exactly 25 UTF-8 bytes: 24 printable bytes plus LF. Payload and consumer digest derive from source input Body, with no trimming.
Boto3 automatically supplied encoding-type=url for ListObjectsV2; the replay explicitly sets the same observed query. CopySource dictionaries become the exact source-event encoded header.
The Go replay explicitly requests CRC32 uploads and enabled checksum reads to preserve boto3's checksum transport defaults rather than comparing different SDK defaults.
The native empty LocationConstraint XML becomes null in boto3 and the empty enum string in Go; source response bytes are retained unchanged.

Direct HeadBucket is Data and requires the native Object selector. After those bucket calls the local replay narrows data selection to AP only, proving the late AP records still deliver without inventing negative delivery expectations.

Control records omit resources and path Name/ResourceArn, retain readOnly and XML request root/xmlns, and have null responseElements. ARN/alias bucket requests retain actual bucketName plus their distinct AP metadata.
Native raw ARN-host GetBucketLocation returns405 MethodNotAllowed; alias returns200. The SDK ARN endpoint-resolution rejection is retained only as a client-side source gap, not a service assertion.
No server access log lines were delivered in the bounded capture; no suppression assertion is made. Uncorrelated data observations remain source evidence only.
